content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline (10+2+3). Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in sourcing, processing and servicing Business Loans and Affordable Housing Loans with Banks, NBFCs, MFIs or Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) is preferred. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel locally for field visits. Knowledge of the local language is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Key Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Sourcing and acquiring new customers. End-to-end management of processing Individual Business Loans (IBL) and Affordable Housing Loans (AHL). Conducting field visits and customer meetings. Collecting KYC and income-related documents. Assisting the BH in credit appraisal processing and disbursement. Maintaining customer relationships and providing post-disbursement support. Coordinating with credit teams. Supporting collection and portfolio quality management. Ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Last Date to Apply (CSE - Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh): 15-10-2026

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is not described on the careers page or in the job description. NABFINS reserves the right to reject any application or candidature at any stage without assigning any reason, and its decision is final. The decision of NABFINS on eligibility, the stage of scrutiny, documents to be produced at selection and other recruitment matters is final and binding. No correspondence or personal enquiries will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Open the NABFINS careers page (nabfins.org/Careers) and select the CSE - Individual Business Loans and Housing Loans opening for your state. Download the file for the job description and application form from the job page. Send your CV to the email ID given in the job description, [email protected] , or to [email protected] as mentioned on the job page. Apply on or before 15-10-2026. For clarifications, contact [email protected] or call 080 26970500.
